plugins.name: credit-card-spending-dashboard
plugins.description: Turn monthly credit-card statement PDFs into one self-contained offline dashboard.html plus Markdown reports. Card-count-agnostic (reads card + month from file content), auto-categorizes and groups merchants and instalments, editable on-screen (hide cards, rename/merge merchant groups, recategorize), and ships no personal data. Start with /update-statement or /update-dashboard — see the README for all slash commands.
